summary.text: New Mexico's House Democrats are rejecting an apparent push — surfaced through a Trump meme — to rename the state, treating the name as inseparable from generations of history, culture and family. The dossier still covers only 2026-09-06, so there is no day-to-day development: three posts from two members, both new to the story. @Rep_Stansbury leads with two, including the anchor ("Oh hell no!... it belongs to us"), and @MelanieforNM adds one. Framing has not shifted; it remains visceral and identity-based rather than procedural, with no legal or legislative remedy named. Open: whether any formal proposal exists, and whether other delegations or leadership engage.
